title: When Does Depth Help? Understanding Layerwise Inference in Tabular Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.19814v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transformer-based tabular foundation models (TFMs) achieve state-of-the-art performance on small to medium-sized tabular prediction tasks while processing diverse inputs through a shared stack of layers. Recent layerwise analyses identify strong predictive performance in early TFM representations and substantial overlap in computation across layers. However, early predictive accessibility alone does not establish whether later layers are dispensable for every input, and aggregate accuracy can obscure which inputs benefit from additional computation. translated_title: 深度何时有帮助？理解表格基础模型中的逐层推理
translated_abstract: 基于Transformer的表格基础模型（TFMs）在中小规模表格预测任务上取得了最先进的性能，同时通过共享的层堆栈处理多样化的输入。近期的逐层分析发现TFM的早期表示已具有强大的预测性能，且各层之间的计算存在大量重叠。然而，仅凭早期预测的可及性并不能确定后续层对每个输入都是可有可无的，而且总体准确率可能掩盖了哪些输入受益于额外的计算。我们研究了TabPFN-3在272个分类数据集上的全部24个上下文学习层，结合了表示几何、预测轨迹、截断和结构干预等方法，同时还考察了另外四个TFM中相关的表示动态。我们发现了一条显著的“扩张-压缩”轨迹，且后期更强的维度收缩与更大的……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过对TabPFN-3全部24个上下文学习层在272个分类数据集上的系统分析，揭示了表格基础模型存在显著的“扩张-压缩”表示轨迹，表明深度对不同输入的帮助程度并不相同，并非所有输入都需要更深的层来完成任务。
en_tdlr: By systematically analyzing all 24 in-context-learning layers of TabPFN-3 across 272 classification datasets, this study reveals a pronounced expansion-compression representation trajectory in tabular foundation models, showing that depth helps different inputs to varying degrees and that not all inputs require deeper layers.
